product.title: Molokini Crater Snorkeling Adventure

description.text: The offshore crater of Molokini has some of the best snorkeling spots in Maui—if you can reach them. Thankfully, this half-day snorkeling tour heads straight for Molokini and Turtle Town nearby on a 53-foot (16 meters) Lani Kai II boat with a 20-foot (6 meters) waterslide. Stops include Ma'alaea Harbor, Molokini Crater, Turtle Town. Visit two snorkeling locations, get the chance to spot whales, and enjoy onboard breakfast and lunch. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
